reason: I need this specific thing and nobody sells it in Baghdad, so I would try them once because the quote shows every fee and says nothing extra on arrival. Two to three weeks is slower than I want, but the agents I know are not faster.
objection: Two to three weeks is a long time when I need it now, and I worry the driver will not find my house and the parcel will sit somewhere or come back with a new charge.
would_change_my_mind: If they could not give me a firm delivery date, or I found the same item in a Baghdad shop, I would not order.
